# Traceability: tests → requirements

The reverse view: every Playwright test and the requirement IDs it is tagged with. Back to the
[overview](README.md).

A data-driven test takes its tag from a test data row, so the row is listed with its own line.

## `api/auth.api.spec.ts`

| Line | Test                                                                     | Requirements                                                                                       |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 11   | login returns the user and /me works with the cookie                     | [AC-AUTH-01](../requirements/auth/acceptance.md)                                                   |
| 35   | /me without a session returns 401                                        | [AC-AUTH-16](../requirements/auth/acceptance.md)                                                   |
| 50   | session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax, body has no token           | [AC-AUTH-31](../requirements/auth/acceptance.md), [AC-AUTH-32](../requirements/auth/acceptance.md) |
| 74   | old cookie is rejected after logout                                      | [AC-AUTH-20](../requirements/auth/acceptance.md)                                                   |
| 104  | rate limit: 5th wrong attempt is 401, 6th with the right password is 429 | [AC-AUTH-10](../requirements/auth/acceptance.md), [AC-AUTH-11](../requirements/auth/acceptance.md) |
